_comment: Render sweep on the jscad modeling engine (sci push jscadui/render-jscad). 22 of the 28 failures extrude a geom2 whose sides do not close; those are sides lost inside the 3D boolean, not anything downstream of it — see docs/backlog.md. packing_circles.scad sits on the 600s guard and has gone both ways across runs. Diff future runs against failures[], not against zero.
tree: main working tree, rsynced onto the CI base worktree by sci — no commit identifies the code that was measured
